description: The fraud used CEO impersonation, business email compromise, invoice substitution, and payment diversion.
Rowan Rook coordinated the impersonation and payment-diversion campaign.
Ivy Ibizan operated the lookalike domains and compromised mailbox infrastructure.
Grant Greyhound controlled the mule stage and dispersed the first payment.
The beneficiary on genuine Copper Paw invoices was substituted from account 2207 to account 8842.
The 420,000 BSC payment was split from 8842 to Grant, Rowan, Ivy, and Harbor Hound.
Penny Pug’s mailbox was compromised by external sessions and forwarding rules.
Bea Barkley was impersonated and did not authorize the payments.
Penny Pug was deceived and did not create the malicious rule.
Copper Paw and Victor Vizsla did not request the changed account.
